## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `4d35cb64606a5d76d75da8ce3d0f119a3217f875`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/filing-gate.md + .claude/skills/checklist-test/SKILL.md (§4), docs/qa/platform-checklist/RUNNER.md (Extraction obligation), .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md (报告契约, same-family fold), .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/rest-channel.md (L16), .claude/skills/dogfood-verification/SKILL.md, scripts/pm/write-pace.mjs (rules ①–⑤, `activeBatch`, `announceBatch`), scripts/pm/issue-create.mjs (header), scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs and execute.mjs (`paceWrite` call sites), scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs (`CEILINGS` row, `MAX_LINE_BYTES`, `countLines`, exemption classes), scripts/pm/check-skill-id-lint.mjs (header), scripts/check-skill-frame-sync.mjs (header), .github/workflows/lint.yml (gate-to-job placement)

Inputs: the PR body, its one-file list, its two commits, the diff against `main` at this head (the two-dot diff against origin/main at 46bb5e3e54 and the three-dot PR diff both reduce to the same 1/1 hunk on L30; `main` has not touched the file since the merge-base 7e7e605de3), the 41 check-runs on the head, and the cited files read at origin/main. Not read: the lane seat's conclusions, and session_01CfRDy7SuTfUqaTu2AEH2Hi, which this reviewer cannot open — so the maintainer's instruction 「你这种集中测试的不应该限制立卡张数，skills 也要调整」 and the approval of the pacing half are both PR-body claims here, and the seat puts them to the maintainer.

### ① Derived judgments

**(a) The rule the new line states, against the old.** Old L30: 「配额:一席每 fire 至多立三张;sweep 超出的折进一张带清单的卡,或折进座位贴。」 New L30: 「配额:一席每 fire 至多三张,超出折清单卡或座位贴;QA/走查逐缺陷立不限张数,守批量间隔。」 Judged correct:

- The carve-out is the clause after the semicolon and names exactly two activities, QA runs and 走查; everything else stays under 「一席每 fire 至多三张」. A sweep is a seat fire and is not QA/走查, so it is still bound at three, and its excess still folds — the old line named the fold for the sweep alone, the new line states the same remedy (list card or seat post) for every over-quota filing. A wider addressee for the same remedy, not a new rule; consistent with L22 (sweep-redirected reminders are ⛔ not cards).
- The carve-out lifts a count and nothing else. It sits inside the gate whose L10 says 「立卡只为四类…⛔ 其余一律不立卡」; 「逐缺陷」 is a category-① product defect (L11–L12), and L13's ⛔ (aesthetic preference, redesign, cost-free performance observation) still refuses a walkthrough's non-defect findings. Categories ①–④ (L10–L19), the three answers (L25), `reach:` (L15), the dedupe query and hit count (L25) are untouched by the diff and unconditioned by the new clause.
- L31 (分诊席的存量清理 in maintainer-confirmed tens, 「⛔ 不因本门改批量」) is about triage's backlog cleanup, orthogonal and unchanged. L32 (reading `User` ⇒ 「本 fire ⛔ 不立新卡」) is an identity predicate, not a count, and the carve-out does not reach it: a QA runner under a user token still files nothing that fire. Read in order, no contradiction.
- SKILL.md L285 「同族发现并入收口卡(一卡覆盖全族位置,带枚举钉子),⛔ 不开单点卡」 is the report contract's family fold: one root cause with several locations is one defect, so 「逐缺陷」 (per defect) and the family fold compose rather than conflict — fifteen unrelated console defects are fifteen cards, five locations of one seam are one. The body's "unchanged" claim holds; the diff does not touch SKILL.md.
- The body's premise holds in the cited text: checklist-test SKILL.md §4 L143–144 「运行中发现的每个产品缺陷,收束报告时逐个抽取为独立 issue…正常进分诊首触」 and RUNNER.md L709–710 "extract each one into its own standalone issue" already require one card per defect; triage-duties.md L42 points 配额 at filing-gate.md, so the old L30 was the only text binding those cards to three per fire. The contradiction was real and the diff removes it; no other file restates the quota (grep over `.claude/`, `scripts/`, `docs/`, AGENTS.md at the branch: L30 is the sole occurrence).

**(b) The scope word.** 「QA」 has a corpus referent: lanes/skills.md L11/L25 (QA 管理循环, QA 波次), the `qa-run` record of checklist-test §4. 「走查」 does not: it occurs nowhere else in `.claude/`, `docs/qa/`, `scripts/pm/` or AGENTS.md at this head (the one grep hit, SKILL.md L294 「归因走查询」, is a different phrase), and neither does the maintainer's own word 「集中测试」. dogfood-verification/SKILL.md (148 lines, §0–§6) has no filing section and never calls itself a 走查, so whether a `dogfood-verification` run is covered is answered only by the PR body ("a QA run (`checklist-test`) or a dogfood / UX walkthrough"), not by the rule text. Bounded, not fatal: the word pairs with QA in one clause, the carve-out keys on 「逐缺陷」 so only a defect-finding activity can use it, 走查 reads as "walkthrough" to a Chinese reader, and by this corpus's own convention (check-skill-id-lint header: a rule's provenance lives in the PR that landed it) the gloss is where a reader is sent. Measured, since the line has zero byte headroom: 「QA/dogfood 逐缺陷不限张数,守批量间隔」 is 119 bytes and fits; 「QA/dogfood 走查…」 is 125 and does not. Whether to name dogfood is the maintainer's word choice (the instruction says 集中测试, broader than either skill); flagged in ③, verdict not withheld on it.

**(c) Measured.** The ratchet's own measure is `Buffer.byteLength(line, 'utf8')` with `bytes(line) <= MAX_LINE_BYTES` passing (wrapLine L2506; scan L2571): old L30 104 bytes, new L30 120 bytes — at the cap, not over. Lines: 64 at origin/main and 64 at the head by the ratchet's `countLines` (split on newline, trailing newline uncounted) against the `CEILINGS` row `['.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/filing-gate.md', 64]` (L1309) — headroom 0, unchanged; the `MAX_TABLE_ROW_BYTES` pin for the file is 0 and L30 is a bullet, not a table row. L7 at 252 bytes is a blockquote, an exemption class, pre-existing. Right, as the body says. The id-lint pattern is /#[0-9]{3,}/ over pm-dispatch markdown: the new line carries no such token. check-skill-frame-sync judges the escalation frame in SKILL.md and scans for undeclared copies of it: L30 is not frame text. Which check-runs answer them: `check:pm-skill-ratchet` (lint.yml L1035) and `check:pm-skill-id-lint` (L1045) are steps of the job `Lint · repo & tooling gates` (job header L543), conclusion success; `check:skill-frame-sync` (L5504) is a step of `Type Check · source gates` (L4991), conclusion success; the aggregators `Lint & Repo Gates` and `TypeScript Type Check` are success. All 41 check-runs on the head are completed; none in progress.

**(d) 「守批量间隔」 and #24755.** The clause names write-pace rule ⑤ (announce N ≥ `DEFAULT_BATCH_THRESHOLD` 5; gap rises to 30 s for those N writes). In the code, rule ⑤ is caller-announced: `announceBatch` has no caller under scripts/pm other than the `--announce-batch` CLI, and `paceWrite` widens the gap only while `activeBatch` finds an unspent announcement (write-pace.mjs L389–390). Every per-op tool — issue-create.mjs L244, post-stamped.mjs L3329, label-write.mjs L593, close-cards.mjs L846, issue-transfer.mjs L283 — calls `paceWrite`, so an announced batch paces them; issue-create.mjs's header spells the contract ("a batch of N cards is N calls of it behind one write-pace.mjs --announce-batch N, never a loop of anything else"). The relay path calls `paceWrite` too (dispatch.mjs L856, execute.mjs L460), but execute.mjs runs on the runner with its own fresh log, so no announcement reaches it and only rule ① (3 s) applies — #24755's measured reproduction, 15 issues in 42 s through one stroke. Two readings decide whether the line is honest: rest-channel.md L16 already binds batches to the per-op tools (「批量恒走逐 op 工具,直调 dispatch.mjs 仅落地」), and #24755's own body records that its bursts were direct dispatch.mjs batches, which that line already forbids. So a filer who does what the new line says — announce, then file through the per-op tools — is paced; a filer who sends a relay stroke is not, but broke rest-channel.md L16 before reaching this line. The line is honest as written: 「守」 states the filer's duty (a duty, not an automatic property — N unannounced issue-create calls get rule ① only, and the announce spelling lives in the two tool headers), the path discipline is rest-channel.md's line, and this file has no byte to restate it. The tool-side gap — the executor applying the batch gap, or dispatch.mjs refusing a non-landing stroke — is #24755's fix (open, `pm:queue`, dispatched), not this line's. The line can stand without naming the path.

### ② Semver level

None. The diff is `.claude/**` only (one file, +1/−1), internal agent tooling that no released package publishes. The PR carries the `skip-changeset` label and the body's `Clause-②: no` line; both `Check Changeset` check-runs on the head concluded skipped, consistent. Correct.

### ③ Boundary flags

1. **The two maintainer claims are PR-body claims.** The verbatim instruction (「你这种集中测试的不应该限制立卡张数，skills 也要调整」, dated 2026-10-20) and the statement that the pacing half was approved in the same session both cite session_01CfRDy7SuTfUqaTu2AEH2Hi, which this reviewer cannot read. Treated as claims; the seat puts both to the maintainer. The diff is judged correct against them as stated.
2. **No os-dev report.** The body's "Gates" section (17 derived commands at 6aede73015, four re-run at 4d35cb6460) is the dev's own claim. The verdicts are the head's check-runs: `Lint & Repo Gates` success; `TypeScript Type Check` success; `Test Core` success (its six shards skipped by the path filter); `Governed Surface Queue Guard` success; `Build Core`, `Build Docs`, `Console Pin Gate`, `Temporal Conformance`, `Dogfood Verify CLI`, the dogfood shards: skipped by the `filter` job (success) for a markdown-only diff, with the `Dogfood Regression Gate` aggregator success; `Check PR Size` success; `Check Documentation Links` success; the four claim/single-writer guards success; `Auto Label` success. No failure, none in progress.
3. **Two commits, one net hunk.** The first (6aede73015) wrote L30 at 117 bytes as 「…QA 运行与走查逐缺陷立卡,不设配额。」; the second (4d35cb6460) rewrote it to the 120-byte line, adding 「守批量间隔」 and compressing 「QA 运行与走查」 to 「QA/走查」 and 「立卡,不设配额」 to 「立不限张数」. The net diff against `main` is still one line out, one in; the first commit's local gate run is superseded by the head's check-runs.
4. **Attribution.** Both commits end with the model-free trailer pair (`Claude-Session:` naming the session URL, and the `Co-authored-by: Claude` line) and carry no model identifier; the PR body ends with a blank line, a rule, and the session-URL footer form (the PR-body form); title and body are English with the ruling quoted untranslated. In form.
5. **An APPROVED review exists on this head** by account `os-zhuang` at 2026-10-20T06:41Z, empty body. Tier S needs no approval — this record is the gate — and the verdict here does not rest on it. `os-zhuang` is one of the two `GOVERNED_APPROVERS`, and platform-readings.md L127 records the skills seat running under that account on an earlier date, so the account is agent-operated at times; Prime Directive 14 forbids any agent seat approving a governed-surface PR under any account. The seat asks the maintainer whether that click was theirs; if it was a seat's, it is filed as a seat violation. Not a defect of the diff.
6. **Landing state.** Draft, auto-merge not armed, head repo equals base repo, labels `documentation`/`size/xs`/`skip-changeset`, no `needs:contract-review` marker (a marker, not a gate). The branch is behind `main` (merge-base 7e7e605de3; `main` read at 46bb5e3e54), GitHub reports it mergeable and clean, and `main` has not touched filing-gate.md since the merge-base, so the queue's rebuilt generation carries the same hunk.
7. **Open for the maintainer (from ①b).** 「走查」 is a term this line coins; the PR body glosses it as a dogfood / UX walkthrough. If the maintainer wants the skill named, 「QA/dogfood 逐缺陷不限张数,守批量间隔」 fits the cap at 119 bytes; if 集中测试 is meant more broadly than either skill, the line as written is the narrower of the two readings and the wider one is the maintainer's to state.

Implemented-by: `claude/funny-albattani-eue8pk`
Reviewed-by: `session_01HEdP5tPhqQfzwRmKDxwn85`

**VERDICT: PASS**
